# P34.9 — M2 ledger-contract validator + no-vacuous-pass (G5 + G11)

**Requirement ids:** **`SIG-ENG-042`** (validators run in `make docs-check` +
the CI `docs` job, owner SEED-02) · **`SIG-MEM-010`** (ledger contract /
evidence-first build memory) · **`SIG-MEM-012`** (`harness:` CURRENT STATE
slot, `Also:`) ·
**Base:** `r11/P34.8-obligation-events-repair` (chain tip — merge after it) ·
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/211_P34.9__ledger-contract-validator-no-vacuous-pass.md`
(manifest row 211 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) ·
**Live stage:** **none** — docs/tooling only; zero production mutations.

## What this does

The control ledger's contract is checked, not trusted: a new
`ledger_contract.py` enforces B3 V1–V6/V8/V11 + B4 V12–V13 against the LEDGER,
its PHASE LOG, BUILD_INDEX, RETURN PASS and GATE DECISIONS regions, and every
named validator now says how many items it evaluated — and exits 3 when it
evaluated none of a non-empty set, so a vacuous pass is red, never green.

1. **`docs/build/tools/ledger_contract.py` (new; `ledger-contract/1`).**
   `check` (worktree or `--at REV`, clock bound to the commit's committer
   time) and `replay FROM..TO` (first-parent LEDGER versions, read-only).
   Thirteen checks — `orient-budget` (≤ 12,288 B, warn > 8,192),
   `current-state` (19 keys in order, optional `harness` slot, declared
   vocabularies, ≤ 256 B lines, no PRIOR, `updatedAt` ≤ commit, `nextTicket`
   = lowest not-landed or DONE), `named-paths`, `stale-tokens` (deny list in
   `record_policy/stale_tokens.txt`), `phase-log`/`phase-log-done`
   (bold-aware parser, pseudo-id allow-list `SETUP`/`OPERATOR`/`ROUND*`,
   end-of-round append position, kinds vocabulary from
   `record_policy/phase_log_kinds.txt`, ≤ 2,048 B, done ⇔ BUILD_INDEX row +
   evidence file), `build-index` (unique seq, no placeholders after close,
   header column count — an unescaped `|` fails, `\|` masked),
   `return-pass` (`returnPass:` = the `### RETURN PASS — current` ticket
   set), `gate-decisions` (table form, kinds, quoted answers, dates ≤
   commit), `orient-probe` (V11), `run-harness` (V12: `Harness: h/m/t` in
   new run ledgers), `manifest-rounds` (V13: chain rows under
   `### Round <n>` banners, ids never reused). Per-check
   `candidates`/`evaluated` + declared floors; exits 0/1/2/3/5 matching
   `memory_guard.py`.
2. **G11 no-vacuous-pass on every named validator.** `check-build-memory.sh`
   gains a generalised `count()` — every counted check flags
   `candidates > 0 ∧ evaluated == 0` and exits 3, with a 0.5 parse floor;
   `OPERATOR` joins the done-entry pseudo-id allow-list; the > 48 KiB orient
   probe is guarded under the guards marker (SIG-LOCAL hunks L4–L6, logged
   in the header). `check_spec_src.py` (`--root` + three count families),
   `check_coverage_matrix.py`, `check_backlog.py` (five input universes),
   `audit_current_state.py` (six inputs + `--require-reconciled`: conflicts
   covered by `reconciliations.json` or a migration-anchor interpretation
   are reported-not-failing; anything unreconciled still exits 1),
   `current_projection.py verify` (digests offered/verified; also fails on a
   projection carrying known inconsistencies or a landing naming no chain
   row), `obligation_events.py check` — all now report counts and exit 3 on
   vacuous. `memory_guard.py`, `check_trailers.py`, `verify_recorded_ci.py`
   already complied (P34.7/P34.2).
3. **Wiring.** `make docs-check` gains `docs-check-ledger`,
   `docs-check-audit` (`--require-reconciled`), `docs-check-projection`,
   `docs-check-planning` (vendored `--planning` over each
   `docs/build/planning/*/META_PLAN.md`) and `check_backlog.py` inside
   `docs-check-matrix`. The CI `docs` job runs `make docs-check` plus an
   explicit `current_projection.py verify` step (V9) on PRs and pushes to
   `main`; no `|| true` anywhere.
4. **Record repairs the new checks caught — appended, never rewritten.**
   Five RETURN PASS rows appended for the `returnPass:` keys the V6 check
   found row-less (P34.3, P34.4, P34.5, P34.6, P34.50 — each owed-leg set
   documented in DEFERRALS). Four landing-correction `e1` transitions
   appended (`D-P34.1-1` P38.1→P38.1a; `D-R6.1-EVAL`,
   `D-P30.2b-1`, `D-P30.2b-2` P31.18→T-EVAL-IND/P34.45/P37.44 per the
   ADR-152 disposition) so every obligation landing resolves to a live
   chain row. `docs/build/reports/current/` regenerated in the same commit.
5. **Tests assert invariants (OM-15).**
   `docs/build/tools/test_ledger_contract.py` — 36 tests: seeded fixture
   pass; per-rule synthetic failures (orient overflow, off-vocabulary
   CURRENT STATE, PRIOR values, deny-listed token, missing named path,
   malformed PHASE LOG, `\|` escapes, GATE DECISIONS forms, harness forms);
   `--at` and `replay`; a vacuous-exit-3 fixture per named validator;
   wiring and removal sensitivity — each fails if the behaviour is deleted.
